origem: ambiguities of addendum 1 resolved in the implementation of the aggregator scripts/v3_G1_agregar_v2.py (sha256 d94fac29dcf6c694cab9bec55c4bdd9e2701fe5baf2675cbfe0aa77a5c155824); they are fixed here before any aggregate exists.

prova_de_anterioridade.nota: no MAE of a real run of the batch was computed or read; the aggregator only ran against synthetic data and in a check mode without MAE.

fixacoes.comparador_Q1: between-seed SD pooled PER CELL and model (square root of the cell's own QM_dentro); the alternative with both cities together is informative only.
fixacoes.bloco3_incompleto: CONTIGUOUS prefix of split draws with all 4 runs complete; k >= 10 split draws with valid nodes per cell within the prefix; only once the batch has finished.
fixacoes.delimita: a cell counts toward DELIMITS when GNN and MLP fall below 2 x the same comparator; threshold 3 of 4 cells (2 of 2 if only the Q1 cells are included).
fixacoes.delimita_parcial: (a) condition 1 at the cell threshold without condition 2 in both Q1 cells; (b) neither rule at the threshold. The residual case with no cell in the 2x-3x band is also PARTIALLY DELIMITS.
fixacoes.paridade: a run without .npz (failed because there was no valid node) is left out of the parity median and is counted and listed.
